title: AC Milan's Champions League scorers
brief: Name the ten players with the most Champions League goals for AC Milan since 1992/93.
period: Champions League seasons 1992/93 to 2025/26, group or league stage onwards

notes.Santiago Gimenez: Santiago Gimenez has scored only once for AC Milan in the Champions League; his other 2024/25 goals were for Feyenoord.

checks: Each player total is the sum of his goals for the club in every season, from UEFA.com season stats and from Transfermarkt season scorer lists; the two agree on every figure shown unless the value gives both. UEFA.com files a mid-season mover's whole season under his later club, so those seasons were split using Transfermarkt game logs. UEFA.com lists Santiago Gimenez with 6 for AC Milan because it files his 2024/25 season under Milan; Transfermarkt game logs show 5 of those were for Feyenoord.
